messages:
Maya: quick check — noticed prefix-cache hit_rate dropped from ~0.92 to ~0.68 after yesterday's shard rebalance (PR #4721). p99 token latency up ~18%. anyone else see this? :eyes:
Raj: saw the same on canary for a couple hours, grabbed some metrics. looks like eviction_count spiked and per-shard occupancy is uneven.
Sasha: eviction sweeps started happening more frequently on shard-7 and shard-3. could be fragmentation after the rebalance.
Maya: hmm. can you share the queries you used? i want to run a short perf harness against those hot prefixes.
Raj: sure, here's the prometheus query i used for hit rate across prefixes:
```
sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (prefix) /
sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (prefix)
```
then looked at eviction_count:
```
sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (shard)
```
Tim: i'll spin up the local harness now. command i run is:
```
./tools/perf_harness --config tests/prefix_hotset.yaml --duration 600 --concurrency 32 --target=canary
```
posting results here in ~15m.
perf-bot: job 8473 queued: perf_harness (owner: Tim) — will post summary when finished.
Sasha: also check kv_fragmentation_ratio and free_chunks_per_shard. fragmentation metric jumped on the same shards. may need a compaction pass.
Raj: i exported a small sample of the shard key distribution. sent to the eng-runtime drive link: https://drive.internal/r/kv/rebalance-dump-20260316
Maya: thanks. if fragmentation is the culprit, short-term mitigation: bump prefix_cache_size by 20% for affected nodes and reduce eviction aggressiveness (eviction_delay_ms -> +200). longer term: add a compaction background job post-rebalance.
Tim: early harness run shows hit_rate on canary goes up from 0.67 -> 0.87 after bumping cache by 25% (toy run). attaching flamegraph in thread: https://perf.internal/graphs/flame-1760870500
Raj: good signal. can we do an A/B on Dedicated vs Hosted? I'd rather not change defaults without canary -> prod rollback plan.
Maya: agreed. proposal: put a rollbackable config (feature flag) to increase cache on affected shards and enable compaction job post-rebalance. i'll open a tiny RFC/ops runbook. PR to pin: #4762 (draft).
Tim: i'll add a short smoke check to the deploy pipeline: verify hit_rate >= 0.85 for top-500 prefixes after change.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 1760875200, changelist: PR #4762 (owner: Maya).
Sasha: tagging oncall @Raj just in case, to monitor eviction_count and p99 after canary. :thumbsup:
Raj: got it, i'll watch dashboards and alert rules (kv_eviction_spike, kv_fragmentation).
Maya: awesome — thanks team. i'll drop the RFC link and the rough runbook in #eng-runtime-docs.
